newsitem.title: UK: British couple shocked as mail arrives in hearse.
newsitem.headline: British couple shocked as mail arrives in hearse.

text.p: Britain's Royal Mail has apologised to a sick, elderly couple who were shocked and upset when a postman delivered their mail in a hearse.

Christine Thornton, 65, and her 72-year-old husband Gordon, suffer from a variety of illnesses and could hardly believe their eyes when a letter from their cardiovascular surgeon arrived in the black funeral vehicle.

"I was awfully upset -- it was the last thing I wanted to see," said Thornton, from Newton Aycliffe in northern England. "It made me really poorly, I couldn't get it out of my mind and didn't sleep all night."

A spokesman for the Royal Mail apologised for any distress caused to the couple. He said it had been an exceptionally busy day and the local postman, who owns the hearse, was working overtime and delivered the post in his own vehicle.
